title: Prevent Fcitx from overriding system XKB settings
summary: Configure Fcitx to stop overwriting keyboard layouts set by setxkbmap or xmodmap, allowing independent management.

steps.gui: Run 'fcitx-config-gtk3' or open it from the application menu.

steps.explain: Go to the 'Addon' tab and select 'Advanced'.
steps.gui: Click on the 'Addon' tab, then select 'Advanced' from the list.

steps.explain: Find 'X Keyboards Integration' in the list and click 'Configure'.
steps.gui: Search for 'xkb' or scroll to find 'X Keyboards Integration', then click the 'Configure' button.

steps.explain: Uncheck 'Allow to Override System XKB Settings' and click OK.
steps.gui: Uncheck the box labeled 'Allow to Override System XKB Settings', then click 'OK'.
